verdict.rationale: Angular Elements is directly referenced (angular-gh-8) as a first-party mechanism for packaging Angular components as standards-based custom elements usable outside Angular apps, which is exactly this story's ask. However, there's no deeper documentation of the API, limitations, or independent hands-on validation of authoring custom elements in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: detailed docs/tutorial on Angular Elements usage, community/hands-on confirmation of custom element interoperability, and discussion of any limitations versus native web component standards.
